answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch, a few slots go to the highest bidders, so each bid anchors real value to an identity: slots start at 10 POA and rise with demand. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns rewards repaying the bid. Faking 100 identities costs 100 auctions: 100 x 10 = 1,000 POA. Idle fakes are flagged violet and forfeit their bids, while the pulse of verified work keeps honest agents paid.
